card.name: Linking words before signaling pathway names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, and, or, downstream right after activation or inhibition terms, where a signaling pathway or protein like MAP-kinase, NFκB, STAT3 or mTOR comes next.

modes.description: A word or letters inside a signaling term, like downstream or RAS, before signaling or effector words.
